scoring.notes: Delegation accuracy (Spec 37, 20.1). Stands in for the session-audit metrics Delegations, Configuration delegation failures, Built-in agent delegations and Category-shuttle success. The fixture declares `backend` and `frontend` categories, and the user describes two bugs that span the HTTP handler (`src/api/orders.ts`) and the data layer (`src/db/orders.ts`). The task spans two files on purpose: Loom's size rule (Spec 38) lets Loom make a one-place fix itself, so a one-file task would no longer measure delegation. The case passes only if Loom delegates to the `shuttle-backend` category shuttle and to nothing else (not the harness built-ins `explore` or `general`, and no agent that does not exist), and `shuttle-backend` then edits the code, which proves the delegated agent's model resolved. This is checked deterministically by `allowed_delegates` from the spawn events and the observer's per-agent edit records. A failed delegation that Loom papers over by editing the file itself fails the case. The fix itself is not verified: this case measures delegation, not implementation quality.
